{{Quote|I have been studying the Tuskens for some time now, and I have discovered they have some items, that they seem to feel are quite mystical. I would like to study these items.|[[Srimaur]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TR" />}}
[[File:GhastlyBaton2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The baton seemed to be surrounded by a ghastly green cloud.]]
The '''Ghastly baton''' was one of three important relics kept by the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] in their [[Tusken Relic Cave|relic cave]]. The baton was a [[Gaderffii/Legends|gaderffii]] stick displayed on the wall inside the cave. It seemed to be surrounded by a ghastly, [[Green (disambiguation)|green]] [[Color/Legends|colored]] cloud.

The baton and two other relics were stolen by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. They were delivered to [[Historian/Legends|scholar]] [[Srimaur]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] for study, but the theft enraged the Tuskens. In retribution, the [[Tusken King]] led an [[Army/Legends|army]] of Sand People to [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|invade Mos Espa]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Ghastly baton appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Ghastly baton was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Tusken Army|"Tusken Army" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:TR" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
